name: Cybervoid Saga — Browser Cache Smuggling
description: ATT&CK coverage for the browser cache smuggling / ClickFix-FileFix chain documented in The Cybervoid Saga (docs/saga). Scores: 100 = highest-fidelity detection priority, 75 = strong, 50 = supporting. See appendix-d-attack-mapping.md.
